issues.title: E[MOIC] mid headline 三处显示不一致: SST/header 标 2.55×, 表内展开式总和 2.53×, v5.md 2.54×; 真实精确值 2.5385 应统一标 2.54×
issues.detail:
Round-5 新引入 capture-probability framework 的 mid 数值发布点不齐:

(a) L2678 §7 header: 'mid 2.55× @ P=0.5'
(b) L2691 表内 summary cell strong text: '~2.55× (capture-adjusted base; range 2.0-3.0×)'
(c) L2691 同 cell 内展开式: 'Total: 1.66+0.75+0.083+0.035+0.006 = 2.53× (mid P=0.5)'
(d) L2696 SST footnote: 'E[MOIC] ~2.55× mid'
(e) v5.md changelog table L36: 'Total: 2.54× (mid)'

精确计算 (无 rounding):
  Bull: 0.35 × 0.5 × 9.0 + 0.35 × 0.5 × 0.5 = 1.575 + 0.0875 = 1.6625
  Base: 0.35 × 0.5 × 3.8 + 0.35 × 0.5 × 0.5 = 0.665 + 0.0875 = 0.7525
  Bear-A: 0.125 × 0.6 × 0.77 + 0.125 × 0.4 × 0.5 = 0.05775 + 0.025 = 0.08275
  Bear-B: 0.125 × 0.6 × 0.13 + 0.125 × 0.4 × 0.5 = 0.00975 + 0.025 = 0.03475
  True Bear: 0.05 × 1.0 × 0.12 = 0.006
  Total: 2.5385

精确值 → 标准 round-to-2dp = 2.54×. 显示为 2.55× 是 over-rounding (2.5385 不进位到 2.55), 显示为 2.53× 是 sum-of-rounded-inputs 截断 error (1.66+0.75+0.083+0.035+0.006 = 2.534 → 2.53).

影响: 同一 SST cell 内 2.53 vs 2.55 ~0.8% gap, 跨文件 v5.md 2.54 加入后 reader 看到 3 个不同 mid 数字. 报告自我宣称 'Single Source of Truth', 但 SST cell 内部数学展开 (2.53) 与 SST cell 顶层 headline (2.55) 不齐. 这是 round-5 新引入的 micro-inconsistency, 不在 round-4 issues 中.

核验:
  grep -n '2.55' v5.report.html → L2678 / L2691 (headline) / L2696
  grep -nF '= 2.53× (mid P=0.5)' v5.report.html → L2691 (展开式)
  v5.md L36 → '2.54× (mid)'
  My recompute: 2.5385 → 应统一标 2.54×
issues.what_would_resolve: 三处统一改 2.55× → 2.54×: L2678 header / L2691 summary cell headline / L2696 SST footnote; 表内展开式 L2691 改 '= 2.53× (mid P=0.5)' 为 '= 2.5385 ≈ 2.54× (mid P=0.5)' 以避免 sum-of-rounded-inputs 错觉. v5.md 已正确显示 2.54×, 是 HTML 滞后.

issues.title: Bear-B 行 sunk-residual 0.5× 高于 capture-conditional MOIC 0.13× — 概念 inversion: 智元 '失败' (sunk 0.5×) 优于 '成功' (capture 0.13×)
issues.detail:
Round-5 引入的 sunk-fund residual prior 是 '0.5× MOIC if 智元 loses to peer in same macro scenario' (L2691 / L2696 引文). 5 行中 4 行 (Bull/Base/Bear-A/True Bear) capture-conditional MOIC 都 ≥ 0.5×, sunk 是下行 anchor 合理. 但 Bear-B 行:

  L2689 Bear-B row: capture-conditional MOIC = 0.13× ($0.5B exit / $3.9B entry, 含 ~3× control premium)
  Sunk residual = 0.5× (uniform across rows)
  → 0.5 > 0.13, 即 '智元 失败' (peer 拿走 macro upside, 智元 sunk equity recap) 比 '智元 成功' (Bear-B exit) 多 4× 倍

语义错误: PE 模型里 'capture-conditional MOIC < sunk' 意味着 '智元 应该希望自己输', 这违反 dominance principle. 在 Bear-B macro (港股 IPO 失败 + distressed M&A) 下, 智元 真正失败 (输给 peer) 的退出值应该 ≤ Bear-B '成功' 退出值 (因为 peer 也面临同样 distressed macro 环境, 输给 peer 不会得到比成功更高的 recap).

数量影响: Bear-B 行 0.125 × 0.4 × 0.5 = 0.025 contribution to E[MOIC]; 若改 sunk = min(0.5, capture_MOIC) = 0.13 (即不允许 inversion), 则 contribution 降至 0.125 × 0.4 × 0.13 = 0.0065, E[MOIC] mid 从 2.5385 降到 2.5200 (-0.7%); 仍在发布的 2.0-3.0× range 内. Quantitatively 小, 但 conceptually 显示 sunk-residual 没经过 row-level sanity check.

类似检查 Bear-A 行: capture 0.77 > sunk 0.5, OK (sunk 是下行); Bull/Base 也 capture >> sunk, OK.

核验:
  L2689 'Bear-B...0.13× (conditional)'
  L2691 'Bear-B: 0.125×0.6×0.13 + 0.125×0.4×0.5 = 0.010 + 0.025 = 0.035'
  Sunk side (0.025) 是 capture side (0.010) 的 2.5× — Bear-B 行 sunk-residual 主导 contribution, 但这是 model artifact 不是 economic truth
issues.what_would_resolve: 二选一: (a) 显式 cap: 'sunk = min(0.5, capture-conditional MOIC) per row', 重算 Bear-B sunk = 0.13×, 总 E[MOIC] mid 降至 ~2.52× (仍 round to 2.5×); (b) row-specific sunk priors: Bear-A sunk = 0.3 (peer 也低), Bear-B sunk = 0.1 (peer macro 已 distressed, 智元 输给 peer 几乎清零). 任一选都要在 L2696 SST footnote 显式注明 sunk-residual 不是 uniform 0.5× across rows.

issues.title: E[IRR] derivation method 从 round-4 linear (Σ p×IRR = 23.6%) 切到 round-5 MOIC-backout (E[MOIC]^(1/5) = 20.6%); SST footnote 未 disclose 方法变更
issues.detail:
Round-4 published E[IRR] = 23.6% via linear probability-weighted: 0.35×55 + 0.35×31 + 0.125×(-5) + 0.125×(-33) + 0.05×(-35) = 23.6% (这是 arithmetic average of IRRs).

Round-5 published E[IRR] = 21% mid via MOIC back-out: 2.54×^(1/5) - 1 = 20.5% ≈ 21% (L2691 显式标注 '2.53×^(1/5) − 1 = 20.6% nominal').

这两个方法给出不同答案 (Jensen's inequality: IRR is concave in MOIC). 若 round-5 用 linear method 应用 capture-adjusted, 我重算:
  Bull: 0.35 × (0.5×55% + 0.5×(-12.94%)) = 7.36%  [sunk IRR = 0.5^(1/5)-1 = -12.94%]
  Base: 0.35 × (0.5×31% + 0.5×(-12.94%)) = 3.16%
  Bear-A: 0.125 × (0.6×(-5%) + 0.4×(-12.94%)) = -1.02%
  Bear-B: 0.125 × (0.6×(-33%) + 0.4×(-12.94%)) = -3.12%
  True Bear: 0.05 × (-35%) = -1.75%
  Linear E[IRR] capture-adjusted = 4.62% (mid)

MOIC-backout E[IRR] = 20.5% (published)
Linear E[IRR] = 4.6% (if Round-4 method retained)

方法切换 16pp gap. 不是 math error (MOIC-backout 是经济学上更合理的 expected-portfolio-IRR), 但 SST footnote L2696 没 disclose 'IRR derivation method 从 round-4 linear-avg 切到 round-5 geometric MOIC-backout'. 一个 careful reader 用 round-4 method 复算 capture-adjusted 会得到 4.6% 而不是 21%, 自然质疑.

此外 L2769 还写: 'capture-adjusted Base contribution to portfolio = 0.35×0.5×31% ≈ 5.4% (mid)' — 这是 linear method (只算 capture side, 不含 sunk side). 如果 reader 把 5 行 linear Base contribution 加起来 ≠ 21% (实际 = 4.6%). 也就是 SST cell 内同时混用 linear 和 geometric, reader 复算两个都失败.

核验:
  Round-4 published E[IRR] linear: 0.35*55 + 0.35*31 + 0.125*(-5) + 0.125*(-33) + 0.05*(-35) = 23.6 ✓
  Round-5 published E[IRR] MOIC-backout: 2.53^0.2 - 1 = 20.6% ✓
  Round-5 L2769 'Base contribution 5.4%' = 0.35×0.5×31% = 5.425% ✓ (linear capture-only)
  Round-5 SST footnote L2696 没 disclose method shift

影响: 这是方法学透明度问题, 不是数学错误. 标 minor 因为 (i) MOIC-backout 是 PE 实务标准 (more conservative + economic-meaningful), (ii) Round-4 23.6% linear 显式 DEPRECATED as ceiling, (iii) Round-5 在表内一致使用 MOIC-backout. 但 L2769 混用 5.4% linear-style 数字与 21% geometric 数字, 不利 IC 复算.
issues.what_would_resolve: L2696 SST footnote 加 1 句: '注: round-4 E[IRR] 23.6% 是 linear probability-weighted IRR (Σ p×IRR_cond); round-5 E[IRR] 21% 是 MOIC-backout (E[MOIC]^(1/5)-1) — 后者 PE 实务更主流, 但与 linear method 因 Jensen inequality 不可直接比较'. L2769 '0.35×0.5×31% ≈ 5.4% Base contribution' 要么删除 (avoid mixing methods), 要么改为 'Base 行 capture-conditional contribution to E[MOIC] = 0.35 × 0.5 × 3.8 = 0.665 (= 26% of total mid 2.54)' 用 MOIC scale.
